summary: End-to-end frontend testing of the newly added WEB app (/app/frontend) against the shared backend. 27/28 flows pass. Landing role picker, Email OTP login (dev_otp shown & consumed), Freelancer jobs feed (202 real jobs loaded, category/search/filter panel work, unverified banner + verify CTA route to sign-in, quota bar visible when verified), Freelancer verification onboarding (4-step wizard renders, coupon WELCOME50 applied on step 1 discounting ₹99 to ₹49.50, Razorpay checkout iframe opens successfully with 7 sub-frames), Employer dashboard/plans/post-job/inbox all render, Freelancer chats render, Pro profile handles unknown id, Live Map renders Leaflet, Categories/Legal/Support pages render, Support form has fields, Employer Plans buy modal opens with pay/coupon. Admin gate correctly blocks non-admin users with an 'ADMIN ACCESS ONLY' lock screen. Admin login flow (as manarastudio22@gmail.com) could not be automated because the backend delivers a REAL email OTP (no dev_otp) to that specific admin address, so no code is exposed in-page for automation to consume.

issues: Step-header numbers 2/3/4 stay black/greyed while locked but never light up as 'CURRENT' — only 'COMPLETED' is highlighted in brand orange. Consider showing next-actionable step in a distinct color for better wayfinding.

Layout is fully mobile-first (centered ≤max-w-md content on a wide desktop viewport). On desktop the whole feed appears squeezed in the middle with huge empty side gutters — this is a faithful port from mobile but feels sparse for a desktop web experience. Consider a wider grid layout for jobs on ≥md breakpoints.

action_items: OPTIONAL: To make admin flow testable in automation, either (a) whitelist admin email in the dev_otp fallback branch so tests get a code, OR (b) document a bypass. Currently admin cannot be signed in via automation because Emergent email delivery is working for that email and no dev_otp is exposed.

OPTIONAL (design/UX only, not a bug): Consider a 2-column desktop layout for the freelancer Jobs feed and the freelancer Onboarding wizard on ≥md breakpoints so desktop web users don't see a narrow mobile column with large empty side gutters.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext.processSessionId is called on every landing load if URL has session_id — correct. However it does not clear a stale localStorage token first; if a previous invalid token exists it will attempt /auth/me and swallow the 401. Not a bug but worth noting.
api.js request helper does NOT retry on 401 by clearing the token — endpoints protected with auth will silently fail. Minor.

usePayments/Razorpay flow: startPayment resolves on razorpay success handler. In the checkout iframe testing we could not complete the actual card entry (external Razorpay UI). Verified via network + iframe open only, per the review request's instruction to not fail on external gateway popup.
test_credentials: Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Email OTP with dev_otp used for anonymous test emails. Admin login (manarastudio22@gmail.com) not automatable because real OTP delivery is enabled for it and dev_otp is not returned.
seed_data_creation: None. Only ephemeral test emails 't{timestamp}@test.local' used for OTP flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web frontend for WorkHop was added at /app/frontend and is fully functional. Route table in App.js. Session token stored in localStorage 'workhop_session_token'; freelancer id 'workhop_freelancer_id'; employer id auto-gen 'workhop_employer_id'. To automate admin: use a non-admin email for login (dev_otp works), then manually seed is_admin in DB OR patch backend to also return dev_otp for admin email in dev/TEST. Razorpay checkout iframe opens and receives correct amount (₹49.50 after WELCOME50 on ₹99). The mobile app and backend were NOT touched this session.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found in the web frontend during this iteration.
